## Fixes

- **Tiles no longer disappear after several walkability edits.** This is the fix from 0.2.65, which was published with the wrong version number, so the app didn't offer it as an update.
  - **Before:** with "This map only", each stroke reloads the map's tile libraries, and the map view kept the previous copy of every tile's image as well. After a number of strokes the graphics memory ran out and parts of the map stopped drawing, until you opened another map and came back.
  - **Now:** once the map view holds far more tile images than the map needs, it starts afresh, so memory stays the same however many strokes you make.
